science.title: ULA Vulcan rocket failure destroys 40 Amazon Leo satellites
science.summary: United Launch Alliance is known for its ultra-dependable Atlas V, but its its latest rocket is off to a shaky start.

science.title: The secret to building Moon bases may be hiding in emergency blankets
science.summary: Scientists have turned the thin plastic used in emergency blankets into remarkably strong insulation that could help astronauts survive the Moon's extreme temperatures. Built from hundreds of stacked layers, the material withstands crushing pressure without losing its thermal protection, potentially paving the way for tougher, longer-lasting lunar habitats.

science.title: Physicists defy expectations by controlling the magnetic heart of a single atom
science.summary: Scientists have unexpectedly discovered how to control the magnetic spin inside a single atom's nucleus using radio waves, overturning previous assumptions about atomic behavior. The breakthrough could pave the way for more reliable quantum memory, although researchers are still trying to understand why it works.
